name: afkswitch
description: Tell AI agents when their human operator is physically away and when they are back.

interface.longDescription: AFKSwitch gives AI coding agents an explicit signal for human physical presence. Invoke $afkswitch:afk when you leave and $afkswitch:back when you return. AFK means physically away, not unreachable, and presence is never permission: agents keep doing already-authorized work while steps that need you at the machine wait. In Codex, AFKSwitch keeps a durable local presence state; it does not claim delivery to other Codex sessions. The state is saved by a small bundled Python 3.9+ script. No AFKSwitch backend, account, or telemetry.
capabilities: Human presence state for coding agents
